leads.title: Software Engineering (recently funded)
leads.posting: Edtech startup Arivihan raises $10 Mn in Series A led by Accel and Prosus. Bengaluru- based edtech startup Arivihan has raised $10 million in Series A funding from existing investors Accel and Prosus Ventures, along with an additional $200,000 from its existing GSF angel investors. The round takes the company’s total funding to more than $15 million. Entrackr recently reported on the company’s new funding and estimated that its valuation had jumped 3.3X to around $60 million. The fresh capital will be used to expand into new states and strengthen its presence in Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Bihar. The company also plans to expand its CBSE offering, develop more vernacular language capabilities and increase its AI research efforts. Founded in 2022 by Ritesh Singh Chandel, Sonu Kumar and Rushabh Kothari, Arivihan offers an AI based learning platform for school students. Its platform provides interactive video lessons, instant doubt solving and AI driven study plans without relying on live teachers. The company currently serves students preparing for State Board, CBSE and NEET exams, with a focus on students from tier 2, tier 3 cities and rural areas. Arivihan said around 80% of its subscribers come from tier 3 cities and rural India. Arivihan will also scale its digital marketing and on ground distribution network as it expands across India. The company plans to hire across key functions and launch new crash courses. Arivihan was previously part of Accel’s Atoms accelerator programme and received seed funding through the programme in March 2024. The company is yet to file its FY26 financials. In FY25, Arivihan’s revenue jumped nearly 14.8X to Rs 3.14 crore from Rs 21.29 lakh in FY24, while the company posted a loss of Rs 4.45 crore.

[https://www.darsel.tech/]
Darsel 0 Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu We help kids learn math. A strong foundation in numeracy and math skills unlocks a lifetime of better outcomes and smarter decisions. Our personalized learning chatbot helps students get there, one message at a time. It’s a simple and effective solution which is designed for scale in low-resource settings. We partner with governments and school systems to reach students. Teachers access reports and provide continuous motivation and support to students, who use Darsel from home. 400,000+ students 3 countries 440,000,000+ questions solved Darsel is an education technology nonprofit on a mission to improve learning outcomes in low-resource settings. We emerged from research at Harvard and Stanford to address a global learning crisis that is limiting human potential and economic development. 1 billion students can’t reliably use video-based educational platforms due to device- and internet-related limitations. We reach them through simple low-bandwidth channels like SMS, WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger . Our platform provides a fully-automated interactive and personalized learning experience for students, and is powered by algorithms that were designed to improve learning outcomes and reverse learning losses. ‍ ‍ Darsel is a supplemental tool for K12 school systems. All our content is curriculum-aligned. We partner with schools and give math teachers data on their students’ skills and needs. Try Darsel Why students love Darsel Simple Using Darsel is as easy as texting a friend, and it meets students where they are, on platforms like WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger. No apps to download. No passwords to remember. Accessible Darsel can be accessed from any phone at any time. Darsel is text-based and requires little data (or none, in countries where SMS is available). No need to wait for a video to buffer. No need to pay for an expensive data package. Effective Darsel’s personalized learning algorithm automatically adapts to each student’s level and provides hints and explanation to address learning gaps. It’s friendly, gamified, and engaging. Why teachers love Darsel Content Our math library contains over 500,000 unique questions, hints and explanations, all aligned to the local curriculum and available in the local language of instruction. Teachers can also customize content or add their own. Analysis Our data reports provide insights about student skills, individually and at the classroom level. If a teacher assigns homework through Darsel, we take care of grading it. Support We’re always a message away. Chatbots are great at helping students learn math, but our teacher support team is 100% human. Subscribe to our newsletter. Newsletter Block This newsletter signup form needs a storage option.
